theme: An open Saturday, girls in Florida.
greeting: A clear Saturday, Dan — nothing on the calendar and the girls are with Jen. The open stretch is yours before tomorrow's 9 AM board sweep with Mike.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC search
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani at Noorani + Partners wrote Wednesday after your call; he's leading the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search for CIFIC and asked whether you'd like to explore it. Still awaiting your word.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged to book back in September and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the hardest rental in that market; a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by was Sept 30 and the book-by was Oct 15, now behind you. Six people over three weeks of the thinnest holiday inventory only gets harder the longer it waits.

needsAttention.title: Tomorrow's Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 9 AM board sweep. Arrive ready to triage the items that have slipped: the Christmas SUV, the December break, the term-life quotes, and the Oct 5-18 Pathfinder drive whose window closes tomorrow.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley savings account
flagged.detail: A final reminder to fund your new Signature Savings account before it lapses.

flagged.title: New message from your clinician
flagged.detail: A note is waiting in the Healow patient portal; it isn't in email.

flagged.title: Brunswick interviews are locked
flagged.detail: Erika confirmed both Oct 27 slots, Jonathan at 10 AM and Christian at 1:30 PM, and the invites are on your calendar.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and booking confirmations: Airbnb in Toronto for Nov 2-5, Kiwi flights, and the usual shops.

resolved.title: Brunswick interviews set for Oct 27
resolved.detail: Erika at Brunswick locked both Teams meetings, Jonathan 10 AM and Christian 1:30 PM, invites already on your calendar.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Autumn brings earthy beets and bitter chicories to their peak — a plate that leans into the season's root cellar.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder south, Portland to St Pete
Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order, bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear calendar with nothing booked, the open morning yours before the week's bookings come due.
No meetings pull at the day, a good window to answer Amin and clear the overdue travel decisions.
A quiet close with the girls in Florida, ahead of tomorrow's 9 AM review with Mike.
